central_hub.rationale: DCs connect innate sensing to adaptive immunity, perform cross-presentation, license other APCs via CD40, prime both CD4+ and CD8+ T cells, and produce polarizing cytokines
central_hub.connections: All T cell types, B cells, NK cells, Macrophages

tumor_core.description: 250-500μm from tumor border, tumor cells directly juxtaposed with infiltrating immune cells
tumor_core.characteristics: High checkpoint expression, chronic antigen exposure, hypoxia, immunosuppressive

invasive_margin.characteristics: Higher density and function of effector cells, active immune responses, predicts prognosis

stroma.characteristics: Physical barriers, distinct TCR repertoires, exclusion patterns

tertiary_lymphoid_structures.structure: B cell follicles (CD20+), T cell zones (CD4+/CD8+), Mature DCs (DC-LAMP+), HEVs (PNAd+)
tertiary_lymphoid_structures.characteristics: Germinal centers, CXCL13 high, predicts immunotherapy response independent of PD-L1

hot_inflamed.characteristics: Extensive lymphocyte infiltration, high T cell density, elevated PD-L1, high TMB
hot_inflamed.cells: High CD8+ CTLs, activated T cells, M1 macrophages

cold_excluded.characteristics: CD8+ T cells trapped at margins, cannot penetrate tumor parenchyma
cold_excluded.barriers: CAF ECM barriers, M2 macrophage barriers
cold_excluded.cells: CD8+ at margins, CAFs, M2 macrophages in core

cold_desert.characteristics: Complete lack of CD8+ T cells in tumor and periphery
cold_desert.features: Low mutational load, low MHC-I, low PD-L1
cold_desert.cells: Sparse immune cells, no CD8+ infiltration

stage_1.name: Progenitor Exhausted 1 (Tex-prog1)
stage_1.markers: TCF-1high, PD-1int, TIM-3-, LAG-3-, CD127+, CXCR5+

stage_4.name: Terminally Exhausted (Tex-term)
stage_4.markers: PD-1high, TIM-3high, LAG-3+, CD39high, TIGIT+, CD160+, TOX+
stage_4.epigenetics: Epigenetically fixed, ~6000 open chromatin regions distinguishing from effector/memory

master_regulator.function: Opens 4000-9000 chromatin regions at exhaustion loci, promotes PD-1/TIM-3/LAG-3/CD38 expression
